assessments.reasoning: Ecma International publishes the controlling ECMA-262 15th-edition algorithm. Fresh direct acquisition returned the exact registered source SHA-256. After the property's presence check, steps 4–6 distinguish an ordinary object environment from a with environment and apply ToBoolean to the same-name value on the unscopables object. In ECMAScript 2024, an Object Environment Record marked as a with environment returns false from HasBinding for an otherwise present property when the binding object's @@unscopables value is an object and the same-name flag on that object converts to true. The binding object has the named property, [[IsWithEnvironment]] is true, the accessed @@unscopables value is an object, and the needed accesses complete normally. This concerns one environment record's binding check. Other records in the chain can still bind the name. A non-object unscopables value does not enter the flag check. A falsy flag does not block the binding in this call.
